implementation_repairs: Original P22 balance workflow omitted an R runtime; the frozen census and selector were rerun with an explicit R runtime without changing scientific gates.

The first selective bridge exposed a latent P21 baseline-representation mismatch; the P22 native executor was repaired while preserving frozen cells, modes, node budget, engine identities and adjudication rules.
Canonical closure used parallel execution only to reduce wall-clock time; it did not alter the frozen experiment.
